result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. In `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`, I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are left out.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still come back with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*DataStore*'` and it passed. That pattern may not have matched any tests, so I haven't confirmed that a test exercises this query. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.
